Coverage_Description: Standard health check-up (physical exam, blood/urine/stool tests, X-ray/ECG) with optional cancer/female/hepatitis B/H. pylori tests; covers eligible follow-up tests for specified abnormal findings and CBC for 2 direct family members if thalassaemia suspected
pricing: Standard Plan HK$1,850; optional items: Total PSA HK$640, Pap Smear HK$470, Breast Ultrasound HK$1,420, CA72.4 HK$990, EBV IgA HK$850, AFP HK$490, CEA HK$700; Female Plan HK$2,830; Hepatitis B Tests HK$490; Helicobacter Pylori Test HK$1,080.
customer requirement: Hong Kong SAR resident; covered person aged 18-70 at application
price structure: Fixed premium by selected package/add-ons; optional items must be purchased with Standard Plan
additional informations: 15-day waiting period; each eligible follow-up test payable once per insured across policy and renewals
